name: Kikumoto Department Store
scope: The surviving Kikumoto Department Store corner and connected financial building at 148–150 Bo’ai Road, Taipei, as photographed in November 2003 with its Cathay-era glass and granite cladding.

references.filename: Cathay United Bank Taipei Branch at Kikumoto 20031130.jpg

originalReview.notes: Photographed from the Bo’ai and Hengyang intersection. The surviving building has a tall glazed chamfer, black-framed mirror glazing bays on both street elevations, dark brown stone strips, yellow Cathay fascia wrapping the ground floor and a vertical sign on Bo’ai Road.

review.method: Exact Qualla original and named native public-domain release
review.notes: The exact 2003 Qualla original matches the native Commons file and its first-party public-domain grant. The surviving bank exterior was selected because it is documented by this original. The 1942 Li Huo-zeng photo was excluded because its original publication history could not be verified.
